title: FlatList not refreshing properly with useInfiniteHits in React Native

comments.body: Hey, this seems like an issue for https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch, I'm transferring it there
@dhayab @Haroenv doesn't hesitate to let me know if this is related to our `clearCache` implementation!
Infinite Hits has its own cache `infiniteHitsCache`, which you can instantiate yourself, and add a clear method to call at the same time as refresh
There's no solution other than the workaround yet, so this is actually a duplicate of https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5263
https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5263#issuecomment-1363061885, and then clearing the infinite hits cache and calling useInstantSearch().refresh should work

> [#5263 (comment)](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5263#issuecomment-1363061885), and then clearing the infinite hits cache and calling useInstantSearch().refresh should work

Ok, after some hours testing this I couldn't come up with a fix using the refresh.

> [#5263 (comment)](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5263#issuecomment-1363061885), and then clearing the infinite hits cache and calling useInstantSearch().refresh should work

Hello there, I'm getting the same error and this component is not refreshing on demand. Any workaround available with this major version? There's one workaround from 2 years ago that I am not able to make it work.

Thanks in advance!
